subject: ci: pin every self-hosted runs-on list to an architecture label (#3552)
summary: Pins every self-hosted runs-on list across all GitHub Actions workflows to an X64 architecture label to prevent x86_64 jobs from landing on the new ARM64 DGX Spark runner, and updates the runner guide documentation.
verdict_reason: A well-scoped CI fix that adds X64 labels to all self-hosted workflow runner specifications and is backed by a review from an ARM/Linux-expert maintainer with all CI checks passing clean.
